answer: Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the dawn until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the relic of the next round. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
